ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the vertical axis is labeled "subtropical high pressure control time (months)", and the values increase upward; the left side of the horizontal axis is labeled "trade wind control time (months)", and the right side of the horizontal axis is labeled "westerly wind control time (months)". Among the five points, ① is located in the upper left, indicating that the subtropical high pressure control time is relatively long, while there is also a certain amount of trade wind control, and it is almost not controlled by westerly winds; ② to ⑤ are mainly located on the right side, indicating that they are controlled by westerly winds to varying degrees. Then reason: Tropical desert climate is usually long controlled by subtropical high pressure and affected by dry trade winds, with little precipitation; if it is obviously controlled by westerly winds, then it is more likely to correspond to Mediterranean climate or temperate oceanic climate, etc. Therefore, the one that conforms to the characteristics of tropical desert climate is place ①.

method.method_draft: 先读图：纵轴表示副热带高压控制时间，横轴左侧表示信风控制时间、右侧表示西风控制时间。①位于左上方，表示受副热带高压控制时间很长，且有一定信风控制，几乎不受西风控制。再读题：要求判断五地中哪一地为热带沙漠气候。运用规则：热带沙漠气候主要受副热带高压和干燥信风控制，降水少；若受西风控制较明显，则更可能形成地中海气候或温带海洋性气候。因此选①地。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中纵轴标注为“副热带高压控制时间（月）”，数值向上增大；横轴左侧标注为“信风控制时间（月）”，横轴右侧标注为“西风控制时间（月）”。五个点中，①位于左上方，表示副热带高压控制时间较长，同时有一定信风控制，几乎不受西风控制；②到⑤主要位于右侧，表示不同程度受西风控制。再推理：热带沙漠气候通常长期受副热带高压控制，并受干燥信风影响，降水少；如果受西风控制较明显，则更可能对应地中海气候或温带海洋性气候等。因此，符合热带沙漠气候特征的是①地。
